{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_0147S6B47VxA1TDVdG5PNk1f","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01G9vR9CSYg4GYFpAbvFgd4s","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/sol.sql","content":"WITH js AS (\n  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, syn.domainid, syn.posid\n  FROM senses s\n  JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid\n),\nss AS (\n  SELECT wordid, synsetid, COUNT(*) AS sc\n  FROM js\n  GROUP BY wordid, synsetid\n),\nranked AS (\n  SELECT wordid, synsetid, sc,\n         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY sc DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn\n  FROM ss\n),\nagg AS (\n  SELECT j.wordid,\n         COUNT(DISTINCT j.synsetid) AS total_synsets,\n         COUNT(*) AS total_senses,\n         COUNT(DISTINCT j.domainid) AS distinct_domains,\n         COUNT(DISTINCT j.posid) AS distinct_posids\n  FROM js j\n  GROUP BY j.wordid\n  HAVING total_synsets >= 2 AND distinct_domains >= 2 AND total_senses >= 2\n)\nSELECT w.wordid AS word_id,\n       w.word AS word,\n       a.total_synsets,\n       a.total_senses,\n       a.distinct_domains,\n       a.distinct_posids,\n       r.synsetid AS top_synsetid,\n       r.sc AS top_synset_sense_count\nFROM agg a\nJOIN words w ON w.wordid = a.wordid\nJOIN ranked r ON r.wordid = a.wordid AND r.rn = 1\nORDER BY a.total_senses DESC, a.total_synsets DESC, a.distinct_domains DESC, w.wordid ASC\nLIMIT 500;\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":607,"cache_read_input_tokens":33487,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":607,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":39,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d19ad1a0-dd46-4aa8-a133-62a9625a835b","uuid":"62a81dd4-2843-432f-a74e-2533bb526ceb"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_01LGppp7WSW6Zp9dL5GvmPUm","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Solution saved to `/app/sol.sql`.\n\n**Result:** 2m14s → 0.46s (≈290× faster), output byte-identical (500 rows).\n\n**Key changes:**\n- **Original** computed `top_synsetid` via correlated subqueries that re-ran per row, and the inner `top_synset_sense_count` had a nested correlated subquery — for each of ~150k candidate words this scanned `senses` multiple times.\n- **Solution** does it in three CTE passes:\n  1. `js` — single join of `senses`↔`synsets`.\n  2. `ss` — per-`(wordid, synsetid)` counts, then `ROW_NUMBER()` to pick the top synset per word in one window pass (no correlated subquery, and `sc` is already the sense count, so the third subquery vanishes).\n  3. `agg` — per-word totals with the same `HAVING` filter.\n- Final join produces the same columns with the same `ORDER BY` and `LIMIT 500`."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":223,"cache_read_input_tokens":34837,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":223,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":60,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d19ad1a0-dd46-4aa8-a133-62a9625a835b","uuid":"7fa5e049-4315-4b12-ba3b-ed9fb2ec0a56"}
